simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גַּחַר (H1515) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: גַּחַר (Gachar) means Gachar , one of the Nethinim First listed occurrence: Ezra 2 47.

definitions.full: H1515. Gachar גַּ֫חַר proper name, masculine head of family of returned exiles Ezra 2:47 ׳בְּנֵיגֿ = Neh 7:49 בְּנֵינָֿ֑חַר .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to hide; lurker;
